# Declared graphics that draw anything in the screen tier: case id, tier,
# then the catalog name. tests/catalog/screen_tier.rs fails when a graphic
# enters or leaves the list, or changes tier, without the list changing.
#
# screen-only: nothing in the geographic tier, so a host that drapes only that
#   tier draws the whole graphic flat on the screen.
# mixed: geographic parts plus pixel-sized parts drawn on the screen.
#
# A graphic whose screen parts are pixel-sized by the standard (an arrowhead,
# a glyph, a tooth) stays listed as mixed by design. Every other entry is a
# graphic whose outline belongs in the geographic tier.
